# `Ruo` 🧁 Ruo is a dictionary-based password cracker written in rust 🦀. The primary purpose is to crack weak hashes/commonly used passwords. Cracked passwords will be printed to the terminal and saved in the file `$HOME/.ruo/hashes.saved`. The `$HOME/.ruo/hashes.saved` file is also used to not load password hashes that you already cracked when you run ruo the next time.

## Available algorithms | Name | Algorithm | Crates.io | |-------------|------------|-----------| | `md5` | MD5 | [![crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/md5.svg)](https://crates.io/crates/md5) | | `sha1` | SHA-1 | [![crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/sha1.svg)](https://crates.io/crates/sha-1) | | `sha256` | SHA-2 256 | [![crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/sha256.svg)](https://crates.io/crates/sha2) | | `sha512` | SHA-2 512 | [![crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/sha256.svg)](https://crates.io/crates/sha2) | |`ripemd320` | RIPEMD320 | [![crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/ripemd320.svg)](https://crates.io/crates/ripemd320)| ## Build From Source ### Prerequisites You'll need the following tools to build from source: * [Rust](https://www.rust-lang.org/en-US/install.html) * `Cargo` ### Building Clone the repository and use cargo to generate a release build. ```sh $ git clone https://github.com/Asjidkalam/ruo.git $ cd ruo/ $ cargo build --release ``` ## Usage ```sh $ ./target/release/ruo ``` ### Example ``` 🔫 ruo v0.1 Loaded SHA-256 hash. Loaded the wordlist file in 838 millisecs. 🤍 Cracked! 244f28ce3685167745ad3a7f1760fd4483bbbb3fd150b9087b95442d4d6fd905 -> "PASSWORD1" in 6 millisecs ``` ## Contribute * Suggest a feature / Report a bug * More algorithms * Better optimization * Help me document the code :) ## License This project is licensed under the terms of the MIT license. Check the [LICENSE](LICENSE.md) file out for license rights and limitations. 🍰

[package]
name = "ruo"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2018"
authors = ["Asjid Kalam <asjid@odinshell.ninja>"]
description = "Tiny hash cracked written in rust."
repository = "https://github.com/Asjidkalam/ruo.git"
license = "MIT"

[dependencies]
instant = "0.1.9"
lazy_static = "1.4.0"
indicatif = "0.16.2"
rayon = "1.5.1"
easy_reader = "0.5.1"
serde = { version = "1.0.104", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.48"
home = "0.5.3"

md-5 = "0.9.1"
sha2 = "0.9.5"
sha1 = "0.6.0"
ripemd320 = "0.9.0"
